calls.thesis: ServiceNow as the orchestration layer between a company's AI agents and AI models, routing agents to the most efficient model and controlling AI costs; revenue expected up 22% this year, $5.3B operating cash flow and $4.5B+ free cash flow, $2.5B cash — no survivability worry; risk is Microsoft, Salesforce and AI developers competing in the same orchestration role; he thinks Wall Street is too focused on software risks and the stock goes much higher.
